tickets.text: Obtain current beneficiary evidence from Velvet Acorn Life Insurance for Arlo Copperwisp's $1.5 million term policy, since the carrier portal shows a different beneficiary arrangement than the Cloudberry Kite Custody planning file summary, before the protection review can be finalized.

tickets.title: Collect estate planning documents and summarize gaps
tickets.text: Request Arlo and Lena Copperwisp's current estate planning documents, organize received files, and prepare a concise gap summary for advisor review. Include wills, revocable trust documents, powers of attorney, health care directives, beneficiary designation evidence, trust funding records, and any recent attorney correspondence. The 2016 Buttonwood Balloon Legal binder names Lena as Arlo's primary agent and Jules Copperwisp as successor trustee; the binder lacks trust funding evidence and the fiduciary roles may not reflect the current household and insurance beneficiary structure. Do not provide legal interpretation; identify document dates, named roles, missing pages or signatures, and items that may require attorney confirmation.

subTasks.title: Request and log estate documents
subTasks.text: Send the standard document request checklist to Arlo and Lena Copperwisp and log each received item by document type, execution date if visible, and file location.

subTasks.title: Review completeness and role information
subTasks.text: Check whether key documents appear complete and note visible fiduciary roles (Lena as primary agent, Jules Copperwisp as successor trustee), beneficiary references, missing signature pages, outdated drafts, or documents that refer to schedules not provided.

subTasks.title: Prepare advisor gap summary
subTasks.text: Summarize collected evidence, open questions, and attorney follow-up items for Nora Pebblefizz before any client-facing recommendations are discussed.

tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to collect the estate planning documents by March 22, 2024.
